title: TaskViewList
description:
GET /api/v1/projects/

/tasks: the tasks the query's filters keep, each with its derived values (docs/layered-architecture.md §6.2)

bytes.description: How big the project's working task data is (tasks.json), for the archive notice

TaskView.description: A task as stored, and what atm derives for it

TaskDerived.description: What atm-lib works out for a task, so no front end applies atm's rules itself

kind.description: The status's kind: todo, active, review, blocked, done or skipped (absent for an unknown status)

ready.description: To do, and every dependency done (an archived one counts as done)

waiting_for.description: A to-do task's dependencies that aren't done yet

waiting_on.description: Who a blocked task waits on: user or agent

priority.description: Its priority, or the project's default

effective_review.description: Its review mode: its own, else its component's, else the project's

effective_release.description: Its release: its own, else its sprint's

stage.description: A done task's stage: done, in_pr or merged (DM-4.3)

status.description: Its status (", archived" added for an archived task), or missing

DepsResult.description: atm deps: what a task waits for, and what waits for it
